configs.ospfd:
hostname P-Core
interface lo
 ip ospf area 0
exit
interface eth0
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
exit
interface eth1
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
exit
interface eth2
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
exit
router ospf
 ospf router-id 172.31.255.4
 passive-interface lo
exit
configs.ldpd:
hostname P-Core
mpls ldp
 router-id 172.31.255.4
 address-family ipv4
  discovery transport-address 172.31.255.4
  interface eth0
  exit
  interface eth1
  exit
  interface eth2
  exit
 exit-address-family
exit

configs.ospfd:
hostname PE-Main
interface lo
 ip ospf area 0
exit
interface eth0
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
exit
router ospf
 ospf router-id 172.31.255.1
 passive-interface lo
exit
configs.ldpd:
hostname PE-Main
mpls ldp
 router-id 172.31.255.1
 address-family ipv4
  discovery transport-address 172.31.255.1
  interface eth0
  exit
 exit-address-family
exit
configs.bgpd:
hostname PE-Main
router bgp 65000
 bgp router-id 172.31.255.1
 no bgp default ipv4-unicast
 neighbor 172.31.255.2 remote-as 65000
 neighbor 172.31.255.2 update-source lo
 neighbor 172.31.255.3 remote-as 65000
 neighbor 172.31.255.3 update-source lo
 address-family ipv4 vpn
  neighbor 172.31.255.2 activate
  neighbor 172.31.255.3 activate
 exit-address-family
exit
router bgp 65000 vrf HOSPITAL
 bgp router-id 172.31.255.1
 no bgp ebgp-requires-policy
 neighbor 172.30.0.2 remote-as 65101
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  rd vpn export 65000:1
  rt vpn both 65000:100
  label vpn export auto
  nexthop vpn export 172.31.255.1
  import vpn
  export vpn
 exit-address-family
exit

hostname CE-Main
router bgp 65101
 bgp router-id 10.10.255.2
 no bgp ebgp-requires-policy
 neighbor 172.30.0.1 remote-as 65000
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 10.10.10.0/25
  neighbor 172.30.0.1 default-originate
 exit-address-family
exit
